description: Fix any remaining validation failures after the LLM extraction pass. Handle edge cases where the LLM output did not meet schema requirements (description too short, missing required fields, etc). Also handle the 4 LOW quality MD files (500-1500 chars) that may not have produced adequate YAML.
steps: Run python3 scripts/validate.py and collect list of any remaining failures
For each failing file, read the YAML and identify the specific schema violation
Fix issues directly in the YAML files - common fixes include: extending short descriptions, adding missing required fields, fixing enum values for domain field

For the LOW quality MD files (morgan-stanley-ai.md at 707 chars, xag-ai.md at 1360 chars, glodon-ai.md at 1377 chars, xkool-ai.md at 1489 chars) - if their YAML still fails, try re-running extract_yaml.py or manually fix the YAML
Run validate.py again to confirm all pass
acceptance_criteria: python3 scripts/validate.py exits with code 0 (all files pass)
No model YAML files have schema violations
verification: python3 scripts/validate.py shows 0 failures and exits with code 0
